description.value: Marquis Wine Cellars is a curated independent wine shop on Davie Street in downtown Vancouver, specializing in a wide selection of wines from around the world including exclusive agency labels from Burgundy, the Rhône, Italy, and beyond. The shop also carries BC craft beer and wine accessories, and offers online ordering with delivery. It sits in the heart of a walkable, cycling-friendly neighbourhood near the West End seawall.
